jobs.title: Program Coordinator II
jobs.description:
**About Abode:**



At **Abode**, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths. When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.


**Our Values:**



We start with dignity, take smart risks, be transparent, solve for today and tomorrow, and spark each other’s strengths in everything we do!


**The Diverse Culture:**



We believe that we make better decisions and provide quality services when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. People of color make up nearly 70% of our workforce and we strive to recruit and retain employees from all backgrounds.


**About The Role**: The Program Coordinator will supervise the provision of services to program participants in the County, through direct staff supervision of staff.


**How You Make An Impact**:


* Provide supervision and leadership and supervision to the assigned team.
* Participate in county wide meetings, provide feedback on successes and necessary system re\-designs.
* Engage in on\-going tracking and evaluation of program goals and effectiveness.
* Provide support to staff when dealing with client crises and problem solving with managers on challenging participant situations.
* Provide feedback, coaching training, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Work with staff to ensure in real time and accurate data entry is occurring.
* Work with Data Specialists on reporting to funders and stakeholders on program activities.
* Monitor assigned employee’s contacts with participants to ensure maximization of funding and program deliverables are met.
* Facilitate case conferencing and administrative meetings.
* Develop materials, assessment tools, job descriptions, and other program processes/documents/tools.
* Develop program policy and procedures, services delivery, and other aspects of the program.
* Other duties as assigned.


**How You Meet Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in psychology, Human Services, Social Work, Sociology, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3 years of professional experience in the human services, social work, or related field and demonstrated experience working collaboratively with low\-income families.
* 1 year of direct experience in the provision and supervision of services to individuals who are homeless and/or have extremely low incomes.
* Flexible schedule to work evening and weekend hours as needed.
* Use of personal vehicle and proof of a valid and current California Driver’s License and current insurance along with a clean DMV record required.


COMPETENCIES:


* Excellent verbal \& written communication, organizational, and time management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to work well independently and collaboratively with teams.
* Strong ability to represent the interests of the agency, interact effectively with a diverse population with multiple special needs, and be comfortable building successful collaborative relationships with tenants, staff, and with community networking and resource building.
* Must have a working knowledge of Psychiatric Disorders.
* Knowledge and ability to implement the following evidence\-based models, Psychosocial Rehabilitation, Harm Reduction, and Motivational Interviewing.
* Experience in building supportive and respectful working relationships with participants and staff.
* Practice and knowledge of culturally sensitive components of direct service delivery through open dialogs and self\-exploration with diverse groups.
* Experienced in effectively intervening in crisis situations using de\-escalation techniques.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, systems, and platforms.
* Ability to learn and use required mobile devices and business\-related applications.
* Outstanding communication skills and high degree of emotional intelligence, cultural humility, with a proven track record to build and maintain effective relationships with a wide variety of internal and external contacts.


**Our Benefits and Perks:**


* **Competitive Pay**: $75,000\.00\-$92,000\.00 (DOE)
* **Classification:** Full Time/Exempt
* **Work Arrangement**: Onsite position; Tuesday through Friday 12:00 PM\- 8:00 PM, Saturday 9\-5
* **PTO**:19 days per year, increasing with tenure
* **Holidays**: 12 paid holidays per year
* **Health \& Wellness**:
	+ 100% medical, dental and vision coverage options for employees
	+ Agency dependent health care contribution
	+ Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
	+ Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
	+ Retirement Plan: 403(b) Plan w/ Employer Match \& Contribution Programs
* **Voluntary Benefits**:
	+ Commuter Assistance
	+ Life Insurance
	+ Legal Services
* **Mission Driven Culture**: Join a team that's passionate about making a meaningful impact in the fight to end homelessness.


**Notice**: This description is to be used as a guide only. It does not constitute a contract, commitment or promise of any kind. Abode Services reserves the right to change, add, delete, upgrade, or downgrade the position as dictated by business necessity at any time with or without notice.


**Notice**: Abode Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Drug Free Workplace


#### **Education**


Required* Bachelors or better in Psychology
* Bachelors or better in Human Services
* Bachelors or better in Social Work


Preferred* Bachelors or better in Sociology

jobs.title: Temporary Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Why Join JVS?**


JVS is a nonprofit working to close opportunity gaps in employment by supporting jobseekers with the skills and confidence to secure quality careers with family\-sustaining wages. Grounded in core values of repairing the world and focused on helping our program participants achieve economic mobility, we believe everyone deserves access to training and the chance for a good job. JVS develops training programs in close partnership with employers in high growth sectors, offering high quality jobs.


Building on decades of experience and success, JVS is a data\-driven organization that takes a whole systems approach to addressing employment and economic equity. Through our direct service programs, employer engagement and policy change, JVS is working toward a future where everyone has access to quality education and training programs that lead to high quality employment and economic mobility.  

  

**Job Summary:**


The Temporary Program Coordinator plays a pivotal role in supporting participants throughout their enrollment and career development journeys. This position ensures accurate assessment, application review, and data management, while also providing personalized coaching and guidance.  

The role involves participating in program orientations, developing career action plans, monitoring participant progress, and collaborating with internal teams and external partners. Success is measured by the ability to meet enrollment and cohort targets, support participant retention, and foster positive outcomes in career placement. A strong commitment to equity, inclusion, and excellent customer service is essential. This role is full\-time, limited\-term, and anticipated to end on 06/30/2027\.

**Responsibilities:**

**Application \& Assessment**

* Review and evaluate program applications for candidate suitability.
* Coordinate and participate in interviews using established criteria to determine participant qualifications.
* Enter and maintain accurate participant records and assessment data in Salesforce or similar systems.

**Program Orientation \& Coaching*** Participate in orientations to introduce participants to program expectations, resources, and support services.
* Provide ongoing coaching and feedback to guide candidates through enrollment and career development.

**Participant Journey Management*** Track and monitor participant progress through career action plans and program milestones.
* Meet regularly with participants during their course and job search phases.
* Refer participants to external services for barriers beyond program scope.

**Support \& Engagement**

* Maintain positive connections among participants, staff, and cohorts.
* Process participant resource dollars and support access to necessary resources.
* Inform participants about their progress and required actions to advance.

**Administrative \& Data Management**

* Document participant encounters and barriers in Salesforce.
* Manage schedules to ensure participants stay on track with program and job search timelines.
* Collaborate with partner agencies and other program staff to ensure effective communication with participants and across agencies.
* Complete administrative projects in support of the Program Team.

**Performance Monitoring**

* Track participant outcomes and support progress toward sustainable wage careers.
* Monitor and encourage the application of behavioral skills in classroom and workplace settings.

**Qualifications:**

* 1–3 years of experience in a similar role.
* Experience working with diverse populations and a demonstrated commitment to equity and inclusion.
* Proven ability to help individuals achieve career or educational goals.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record\-keeping.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn Salesforce or similar CRM systems.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for building rapport with participants and stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time management skills to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Ability to analyze participant needs and develop personalized action plans.
* Competence in documenting and tracking participant progress using CRM systems.
* Strong problem\-solving skills to address participant barriers and critical incidents.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team and with external partners.
* Flexibility and adaptability to meet changing organizational and participant needs.
* High degree of initiative, integrity, and professionalism.
* Commitment to the mission and values of JVS.
* Positive attitude and genuine desire to help participants succeed.


**What We Offer*** $3,062\.50 per pay period
* 100% covered medical and dental plans for the employee
* Accrued sixteen (16\) days of Vacation \+ accrued ten (10\) days of Paid Sick Leave
* Paid federal and Jewish holidays
* 3% 403(b) retirement contribution match and 3% non\-elective contribution
* Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
* Pet Insurance Discounts
* Employee Assistance Program
* The expectation for this role is to work in our San Francisco office and/or worksites on a hybrid work schedule; JVS does not provide relocation packages
* 4 Day Work Week

*As an Equal Opportunity Employer, JVS is committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified individuals and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information or characteristics, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We welcome diverse applicants. Please let us know if you need accommodations or auxiliary aids for the interview process.*

We're looking for a **Program Coordinator** for the **San Jose, CA area!**

**Specifics:**

* **Job classification:** Non\-Exempt, 10 hours per week
* **Job Location:** San Jose, CA
* **Pay rate:** $21\.00 ph
* **Skills:** Experience working with youth ages 5 through 17; small\- and large\-group classroom management skills; excellent communication and organizational abilities.

**Our Philosophy**

**LifeSTEPS** is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services. The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for “**S**kills **T**raining and **E**ducational **P**rograms” and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by LifeSTEPS will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.




**About us**


LifeSTEPS, is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit charitable organization. It was founded in 1996 and currently has over 440 partnered affordable housing properties all over the state of California. We serve several regions from Sacramento, Bay Area, South Bay, Central Valley, LA County and Inland Pacific regions. We work with 115,000 residents all over the state and we’re on a mission to provide effective educational and supportive services to maximize the strengths of individuals and build resilient communities.




**Our Benefits**


In addition to meeting your passion for making a difference in the lives of those we serve, all employees will receive the following benefits:

* Competitive pay based on skill and experience
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program

Benefit eligible employees working 30 hours per week or more will also receive:

* Medical, Dental Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Identity Theft Program
* Pet Insurance
* Paid Time Off




**About the Position**


The **Program Coordinator,** under the direction of the Regional Director of Social Services, is expected to design, implement, and coordinate activities and programs within assigned affordable housing complexes. This position works closely with the Director of Social Services (DSS) to provide the highest quality of service to the residents served by LifeSTEPS.




**Core Duties** **Program Coordinator**


* Empower children from low\-income and underserved families to flourish by providing after\-school education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go after school to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

* High School Diploma or equivalent.

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, or related field preferred.

jobs.title: Office Manager, San Francisco
jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go\-to\-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1\.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

**About the Role**
------------------



Apollo is opening a new office in San Francisco, and we're looking for an Office Manager to own the day\-to\-day operations of the space. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, this person will make sure the office is safe, welcoming, and productive, from front\-of\-house hospitality to vendor coordination to onboarding logistics.



This role is about more than keeping the lights on. You will bring structure and follow\-through to a growing office, working closely with the Chief of Staff, IT Team, and People Team to keep operations running smoothly as the team scales. You will set the tone for anyone who walks through the door, whether that is a new hire on day one or a visiting executive.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail oriented, and genuinely enjoys creating a great workplace experience. You are just as comfortable managing vendors and logistics as you are greeting a visitor with a warm welcome.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Office Operations \& Vendor Management**


* Support the day\-to\-day operations of the office environment to ensure it remains safe, welcoming, and productive.
* Collaborate with the Chief of Staff to implement office policies, coordinate logistics, and support company initiatives.
* Coordinate with building management and approved vendors, including maintenance, cleaning, snacks, and supplies, under guidance from the Chief of Staff.
* Maintain inventory of office supplies and oversee restocking of all common areas.
* Report and follow up on facility maintenance issues, working closely with building management and approved vendors. Obtain a minimum of three invoices or quotes per service, per policy.
* Coordinate vendors and contractors end to end: schedule the work, follow through, and catch issues before they become visible problems.

### **Workplace Experience, Onboarding \& Events**


* Greet visitors and ensure a smooth check\-in experience that reflects Apollo's brand and hospitality standards.
* Manage badge and access administration, including access for visitors, card deactivation, and a monthly review of active access cards.
* Own onsite onboarding activities and office onboarding logistics in collaboration with IT and People Ops, including welcome and orientation touchpoints.
* Help coordinate in\-office events, employee recognition moments, and team gatherings with direction from the Chief of Staff.
* Maintain organization and daily presentation of communal spaces such as kitchens, conference rooms, and shared desks.

### **Health, Safety \& Compliance**


* Assist in safety procedures and help coordinate office readiness, such as fire drills and ergonomic checks.
* Ensure signage, office protocols, and emergency materials are maintained and up to date.
* Act as a point of contact during minor incidents or office\-related disruptions, escalating appropriately to building management and leadership.
* Work closely with Apollo's safety and compliance stakeholders on any office\-related safety requests.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------



In this role, success means:


* The office runs smoothly day to day, and issues are resolved before they become disruptions.
* Vendors and building management are handled proactively, with clear documentation and cost discipline.
* New hires have a welcoming first day, and visitors leave with a strong impression of Apollo.
* The Chief of Staff, IT, and People Team all consider this person a reliable partner.
* Office events and team moments feel organized and well executed.
* Safety protocols and compliance requirements are consistently met.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* 3 to 5 years of experience in administrative, office management, workplace operations, hospitality, or facilities coordination roles.
* Experience supporting an in\-office team in a startup or corporate environment.
* **Organization:** Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple requests at once.
* **Communication:** Clear, friendly communication style, written and verbal, with a service\-oriented, hospitality mindset.
* **Follow\-through:** Proven ability to follow processes, stay on top of logistical details, and own assigned responsibilities.
* **Vendor management:** Working knowledge of vendor coordination, invoices, and budget review.
* Comfortable using tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, calendar management software, and ticketing or help desk platforms.
* Comfortable using AI tools to boost day\-to\-day productivity, such as drafting and summarizing, and able to critically assess AI\-generated content.
* Full\-time, on\-site availability in San Francisco, five days a week.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------



You may be a strong fit if you are:


* Someone who sets a warm, professional tone for anyone entering the office.
* Proactive and solutions\-focused, comfortable anticipating needs in a fast\-paced, changing environment.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  

Spectro Cloud helps platform teams and cloud providers modernize and manage infrastructure for the AI era without adding more tools or operational complexity.


With PaletteAI, enterprises, public sector organizations, neoclouds and sovereign clouds can build, govern and operate full\-stack environments across VMs, Kubernetes, edge, regulated and air\-gapped locations, and AI infrastructure. PaletteAI Launchpads help teams start quickly with urgent outcomes such as VMware migration, token cost control or edge modernization, then scale into enterprise\-wide lifecycle management, governance and fleet operations on the same platform.

**About the Team**  

Marketing at Spectro Cloud runs fast, and the systems underneath need to keep up. We're hiring our first dedicated Senior Marketing Operations Manager to own the plumbing that makes everything work — the workflows, the data, the leads, the nurtures, and the reporting that leadership and the board rely on. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role reporting to the Director of Demand Gen. You'll be the person who makes marketing operations a durable, well\-architected system that scales with the business. You'll partner closely with demand generation, field marketing, web, sales, and RevOps, and you'll have a direct line into how pipeline gets built, measured, and reported.
  

  

**What You'll Do**
  

Lead flow, system architecture, and automation
* Own how leads move through HubSpot and into Salesforce end\-to\-end
* Build and maintain campaign workflows
* Manage HubSpot Salesforce integration, field mapping, and lifecycle stage handoffs
* Add and maintain the properties needed for routing, reporting, and sales visibility
* Troubleshoot sync errors and process breakdowns as they arise

  

Campaign and event operations
* Manage landing pages, forms, and campaign assets in HubSpot
* Upload and process event lead lists; route qualified leads into the right nurture sequences
* QA campaign setup end\-to\-end — from lead capture through Salesforce sync
* Ensure lead source and channel tracking is consistent, complete, and reportable across trade shows, website, SEO, social, ABM, and paid programs

  

Data quality and system maintenance
* Own the ongoing integrity of marketing data.
* Monitor and resolve sync errors, incomplete records, and misrouted leads
* Investigate individual records when qualification, source, or history is questioned
* Own and enforce a consistent cross\-team UTM structure for digital campaigns

  

Lead scoring and lifecycle management
* Maintain and continuously improve the lead scoring and qualification model used by Marketing and Sales

 Ensure lifecycle stage definitions are clear, consistently applied, and aligned with how Sales works leads Nurture operations Build and maintain nurture programs in HubSpot, including entry/exit logic and progression rules
* Monitor performance and report on whether programs are actually moving leads forward
* Manage one off email sends for event invitation/follow up etc.

  

Reporting, dashboards, and attribution
* Build the reporting foundation for pipeline sourced and influenced by marketing, by source and channel
* Deliver campaign ROI reporting: target, actual, and attainment
* Maintain separate reporting views for Commercial and Public Sector
* Produce quarterly board\-ready reporting, including sourced/attributed vs. assisted/influenced, open vs. closed\-won, and created\-in\-quarter vs. trailing
* Develop a first version of a multi\-touch attribution model, and iterate from there

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

* 6\+ years in marketing operations at a B2B SaaS company, with at least 2–3 years at a senior/lead level in a builder role.
* Long term strategic thinker with a builder mindset.
* Deep, hands\-on HubSpot expertise — workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, custom properties, sync management, settings. You should be able to open HubSpot on day one and know exactly where to look.
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce and of the HubSpot–Salesforce integration specifically (field mapping, sync rules, common failure modes)
* Experience owning lead routing, lifecycle management, and lead scoring end\-to\-end
* Track record of building nurture programs that actually move pipeline
* Comfort with attribution — multi\-touch models, sourced vs. influenced, and the tradeoffs between them
* Strong data instincts: you notice when numbers don't add up, and you know how to trace them back to the source
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills — this role sits at the seam between Marketing, Sales, and RevOps
* Comfortable operating autonomously in a fast\-moving, less\-than\-fully\-built environment
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Hands on experience with ABM platforms (6Sense, DemandBase), intent data tools, lead routing (LeanData)
* HubSpot Marketing Software and/or Salesforce Administrator certifications
* Experience building marketing ops from an early stage rather than inheriting a mature stack

  

Location: This role is hybrid in San Jose, CA. We are in office 3x a week, 2x WFH.  

Remote candidates in the Bay Area and in US will still be considered for this role.  

  

The On\-Target Earnings for this role is $142,500\-$195,500 \+ Equity.

jobs.title: Operations Manager for Superconducting Device Fabrication Facility
jobs.description:
Job Overview
  
  

You are invited to apply for the position of Operations Manager for the Detector Microfabrication Facility (DMF) in the Fundamental Physics Directorate (FPD) at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory. The Operations Manager is responsible for directing the operation of the DMF cleanroom and supporting technical systems (e.g. deposition and fabrication tools, tool utilities, metrology laboratory) to enable the fabrication of state\-of\-the\-art superconducting microelectronics devices in the DMF to support SLAC’s scientific mission. To fulfill this responsibility the Operations Manager has the authority to:
  
  

Manage the DMF and associated external facilities.
  
  

Hire and manage the DMF staff including engineers and technicians.
  
  

Implement the process controls, operations procedures, and training standards for all DMF work.
  
  

Manage the allocation of DMF resources.
  
  

Work with the DMF Director and their team to ensure DMF serves the needs of its users
  
  

The Detector Microfabrication Facility (DMF) is an ISO\-5 cleanroom with a dedicated toolset for the R\&D and at\-scale production of superconducting devices and sensors with high uniformity, complexity, yield, and reproducibility. In addition to a specialized toolset on 150mm wafers, the DMF also includes necessary capabilities for post\-fabrication metrology, room\-temperature and cryogenic characterization, and validation of functionality and performance of devices produced at the DMF. The facility is envisioned to support DOE mission science by enabling collaborative research across universities, labs and industry in quantum information science and fundamental physics. The DMF is managed by the Fundamental Physics Directorate (FPD). The FPD brings together scientists and technologies that support national priorities in particle physics, astrophysics and cosmology to explore the basic particles and forces that knit the cosmos together. As a key member of the DMF management team, you will report to the DMF Director.
  
  

**Your specific responsibilities will include:**  

Management of all operations in the Detector Microfabrication Facility; cleanroom, tool suite, and metrology lab.
  
  

Support of the scientific user base in optimizing device fabrication, while maintaining stringent standards for core process stability and purity.
  
  

Support of SLAC leadership in the strategic and financial planning for the DMF.
  
  

Scheduling and coordination all work in the DMF.
  
  

Management of the online portal(s) for tool status and reserving/logging of tool usage and operator hours.
  
  

Hiring and management of the DMF core team (tool engineers, process engineers and technicians). Work with the Scientific Direction to help build a team of device scientists to complement the operations team.
  
  

Building SLAC's values (excellence, integrity, collaboration, respect, and creativity), and safety into every aspect of the DMF core team’s work and culture.
  
  

Engagement of matrixed SLAC staff or external contracted resources where appropriate to augment DMF core staff.
  
  

Assuring that all DMF operations are performed safely and in compliance with SLAC, Stanford, and Government requirements and regulations, in collaboration with SLAC Environment, Safety \& Health (ESH) staff.
  
  

Establish and communicate to staff and users the safety protocols for use of the facility and its tools, coordinating with ESH as necessary.
  
  

Establish the qualifications and training requirements for staff and users to access and work in the DMF facility.
  
  

Develop and manage the DMF\-specific staff and user training.
  
  

Plan tool acceptance activities and develop procedures for tool startup and commissioning when new tools are introduced to the facility. Maintain standard operating procedures for facility tools including deposition, etching, lithography and metrology tools and wet benches.
  
  

Plan and manage the maintenance of DMF tools (e.g., lithography, etching, deposition, wet benches, SRDs) coordinating preventative maintenance schedules and servicing. Procure maintenance contracts for the major fabrication tools.
  
  

Plan and manage the maintenance of DMF subsystems (e.g., ultra\-pure water, process vacuum, utility nitrogen, acid waste neutralization) coordinating preventative maintenance schedules and servicing. Coordinate with Facilities \& Operations (F\&O) on the development and execution of regular cleanroom maintenance of F\&O\-managed systems and utilities. Procure maintenance contracts where appropriate.
  
  

Plan and manage the maintenance of DMF metrology tools (e.g., dilution refrigerator) coordinating preventative maintenance schedules and servicing. Procure maintenance contracts where appropriate.
  
  

Maintain cleanroom materials catalogs and documentation and establish protocols for safe handling of materials and waste; maintain stock of common cleanroom supplies and consumables.
  
  

**To be successful in this position you will bring:**  

Demonstrated excellence in leading disciplined operations at a research cleanroom facility.
  
  

Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of relevant experience in a science or engineering discipline relevant to the DMF’s mission in performing the above listed duties.
  
  

Experience fostering an environment that cultivates innovation and groundbreaking R\&D while simultaneously ensuring delivery to sponsors and projects.

Strategy \& Operations \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity.


The Business Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence by developing and executing strategies that drive awareness amongst core business audiences.


The Strategy \& Operations function supports Business Marketing with operating models and cadences; strategic planning; portfolio, resource, and investment management; measurement and organizational learning that empower our teams to move at pace with clarity and confidence.


**About the Role**


We’re looking for a resourcefuling marketing campaigns. You’ll manage our marketing portfolio and intake process, lead selected cross\-functional projects, and build AI\-enabled tools that make it easier for marketers to get their work done.


You’ll be the first partner for new requests: understanding the business need, sizing the work, and finding its best home. You’ll connect requests to existing campaigns and programs where possible, establish clear ownership, and make sure teams have the context and structure they need to move quickly.


This role combines an integrated marketing mindset with hands\-on project management and a builder’s instinct. You should enjoy being the person everyone reaches out to, making sense of ambiguity, and seeing how a small ask might become a much bigger thing—or when a big ask is actually something quite small. This role makes everyone’s life a little easier by providing a better understanding of what’s happening across the entire department, a clear way to kick off work with the right people, high\-touch support for our most intense projects, and useful systems that take friction out of everyone’s day.


**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------


* **Lead selected cross\-functional projects.** Build the model by program\-managing some of our biggest the process.
* **Run marketing intake and triage.** Clarify the audiences. Find a path to “yes, we can” for most requests, and feel comfortable telling a stakeholder “why not” if that’s truly the best answer.
* **Manage the ongoing marketing portfolio.** Maintain a clear view of active and upcoming work. Use your deep knowledge of the portfolio—including team members’ responsibilities and availability—to push for single\-threaded, named leadership when there are multiple contributors.
* **Find the right home for the work.** Determine whether a request belongs within an existing campaign, needs integrated marketing involvement, warrants a standalone project, or can be handled through self\-service. Understand that every request is important for some reason and treat it as such, while still making recommendations grounded in business priorities.
* **Set projects up for effective collaboration.** Create clarity by naming accountable ownersation structure. Use AI workflows to kick off briefs and project spaces and appropriately capture status updates and decision records.
* **Partner closely with Creative Operations.** Bring creative partners in early to help shape briefs and assess feasibility and production needs. Ensure Creative Operations has what it needs to assign creative staff, estimate capacity, scope agency agreements, and create production timelines.
* **Build and improve AI\-enabled tools and workflows.** Personally prototype and implement practical ways to improve intake, brief development, project setup, portfolio visibility, and reporting. Test with users, maintain appropriate human review, and improve what actually saves people time.
* **Make the operating model easier to use.** Use team feedback and delivery patterns to simplify processes, strengthen self\-service, and reduce repetitive coordination. Build systems that remain useful as the team and volume of work grow.

**You might thrive in this role, if you have:**
-----------------------------------------------


* 7\+ years of experience in marketing program and project management, integrated marketing management, or marketing portfolio management across multiple teams and concurrent priorities.
* A track record of personally leading cross\-functional projects, establishing ownership, managing dependencies, and driving work through to completion.
* An integrated marketing mindset: you see beyond an individual deliverable to understand its audience, purpose, campaign context, and relationship to other work.
* Strong judgment in ambiguous situationsation.
* Experience designing intake processes, project structures, and portfolio systems that people adopt and prefer to use because they make their lives easier.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Client Delivery
jobs.description:
**Vivodyne creates human data before clinical trials.**
-------------------------------------------------------



We accelerate the successful discovery, design, and development of human therapeutics by testing on large, lab\-grown human organ tissues at massive scale, driving technological advancement at the convergence of novel biology, robotics, and AI. We identify and validate new therapeutic targets and de\-risk new therapeutic assets by producing clinically translatable multi\-omic data from our proprietary, physiologically\-realistic human organ tissues at unprecedented scale, speed, and quality. This enables us to produce more human data than all clinical trials in the U.S. combined. We’re financially backed by some of the most selective and successful venture funds, and we have already partnered with a majority of the top 10 multinational pharmaceutical companies to discover and develop better, safer drugs and dramatically reduce the burden of animal testing.



www.vivodyne.com


**Role**
--------



Vivodyne is seeking a **Senior Program Manager, Client Delivery** to lead the operational delivery of complex client programs across Vivodyne’s scientific, technical, and commercial teams. This person will serve as a primary internal coordinator and, for assigned accounts, a client\-facing program lead. They will translate work plans into executable schedules, maintain clear communication, surface risks early, and ensure delivery commitments remain visible across teams.



This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in San Francisco, working closely with a bicoastal delivery team, with occasional travel to our Philadelphia site.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


#### **Client Engagement \& Delivery**


* **Own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of complex client programs**, accountable for delivering against agreed scope, timelines, budget, and client commitments from kickoff and work\-plan alignment through execution, data delivery, closeout, and subsequent phases. Programs may span multiple technical workstreams, sites, external partners, and extended timelines.
* **Act as a consistent client\-facing program lead** for assigned accounts, establishing communication cadence, coordinating key decisions and follow\-ups, providing clear status updates, and raising schedule or deliverable risks early.
* **Lead client kickoff and delivery planning**, ensuring work plans, dependencies, ownership, collaboration workflows, and legal or operational prerequisites are aligned before execution.
* **Coordinate data and documentation delivery**, establishing clear expectations, ownership, and timelines for technical reports, assay and methods documentation, data packages, presentations, and client communications.

#### **Internal Stakeholder Alignment \& Resource Management**


* **Build and maintain integrated program plans** covering milestones, dependencies, study schedules, resources, owners, risks, and delivery dates, providing practical execution guidance when programs compete for shared resources.
* **Coordinate cross\-functional execution** across biology, operations, microfabrication, hardware/software, data analysis, business development, and leadership. Translate program objectives and requirements into clear internal context, decisions, and next steps.
* **Manage scope, capacity, and schedule trade\-offs**, identifying constraints across resource availability, product readiness, staffing, materials, technical development, client requirements, and operational capacity; facilitate decisions and communicate their implications.
* **Run portfolio\-level delivery operating rhythms**, including weekly reviews and leadership updates that surface priorities, risks, decisions, and cross\-team dependencies.
* **Maintain a reliable system for program and portfolio management**, ensuring project plans, ownership, dependencies, risks, and status remain current and visible across teams.

#### **Strategy \& Operational Excellence**


* **Coordinate internal R\&D and tissue roadmap execution** in partnership with biology and product leads, translating scientific priorities into executable plans, milestones, and timelines. Balance internal model and capability development with client delivery commitments.
* **Partner with BD and leadership on feasibility, resourcing, pricing, and delivery planning** for prospective and expanding client work, helping evaluate scope alternatives, timelines, cost inputs, and operational feasibility.
* **Improve delivery processes and knowledge transfer** by documenting repeatable workflows, clarifying ownership, creating training materials, and ensuring critical program and account knowledge is transferable across the team.
* **Lead and champion program management best practices**, creating consistent ways of working across teams for planning, execution, risk management, communication, and delivery

### **What success looks like**


* Client programs are delivered against agreed scope, timelines, budget, and client commitments, with deviations proactively managed and communicated.
* Clients have a clear, reliable view of milestones, deliverables, owners, and changes.
* Internal teams understand the scientific and commercial context of their work.
* Risks and dependency conflicts are identified and addressed early, with explicit options and decisions.
* Program plans reflect reliable data and actual operational capacity rather than only desired timelines.
* Data, methods, and client\-facing materials are delivered in an organized, predictable way.
* Program knowledge is well\-documented for clean account ownership transfers.
* Client delivery and internal R\&D priorities are effectively balanced and coordinated.

**Requirements and Expectations**
---------------------------------


* 5\+ years of experience leading complex, cross\-functional programs in biotech, pharma, life sciences, CRO/CDMO, healthcare technology, or a similarly technical client\-delivery

jobs.title: IT Sr. Project Manager, Helen Diller Hospital
jobs.description:
The Senior IT Project Manager will lead planning, coordination, and execution of IT workstreams supporting the Helen Diller Hospital project, a multi\-year, large\-scale capital initiative. This role will oversee technology program delivery across clinical applications, infrastructure, and end\-user systems to ensure alignment with hospital operational readiness and strategic goals. Responsibilities include managing scope, schedule, budget, risks, and dependencies across diverse stakeholder groups; facilitating decision\-making between IT, construction, and clinical leadership; and ensuring regulatory, security, and patient safety requirements are met. The Senior IT Project Manager will serve as a primary liaison between IT leadership, project governance, and vendor partners, providing executive\-level visibility into progress, issues, and mitigation strategies.


As a Senior IT Project Manager for the Helen Diller Hospital project, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of healthcare delivery. This position is responsible for planning and implementing fully integrated IT solutions to support the new Helen Diller Hospital at Parnassus Heights. The work involves implementing IT services that are future\-ready, adaptable to emerging technologies, and capable of supporting smooth transitions over time.  



This role requires a deep understanding of institutional, medical center, and systemwide priorities, as well as long\-term strategic goals. You will lead and manage complex IT workstreams with broad institutional impact, requiring sophisticated analysis, cross\-functional collaboration, and innovative problem\-solving.  



As a recognized subject matter expert and senior leader in project management, you will influence methods, standards, and best practices across the organization. Your expertise will not only guide the Helen Diller Hospital initiative but will also shape how large\-scale IT projects are managed across the campus, medical center, and broader UC system.  



The new 15\-story, 875,000 gross\-square\-foot (GSF) hospital will enable UCSF to provide much\-needed capacity for additional acute, emergency and intensive care beds, meet the state’s seismic requirements, and provide an optimal healing environment that addresses social, psychological, spiritual, and behavioral components of health in one place. The holistic focus on the needs of patients reflects UCSF’s integrated research, education and care delivery mission at Parnassus Heights. The new hospital will incorporate the latest innovations in technology and equipment for advanced complex care and bridge scientific research discoveries from bench to bedside leading to accelerated innovative treatments and therapies to benefit patients.  



UCSF Health is a growing regional health system that includes UCSF Medical Center, the top\-ranked hospital in California and among the top five nationally, according to U.S. News \& World Report. The new hospital will be embedded within a campus that includes leading clinicians and scientists focused on translating discoveries into treatments and cures. UCSF Helen Diller Medical Center is part of a planned broader revitalization of the Parnassus Heights campus that also will modernize facilities supporting our research and education priorities.  



As a key member of the multi\-disciplinary UCSF Health IT team, you will be at the front line of creating the next generation of healthcare delivery. jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------



We are Sila, a next\-generation battery materials company. Our mission is to power the world's transition to clean energy. To create this future, our team is building a better lithium\-ion battery from the inside out today. We engineer and manufacture ground\-breaking battery materials that significantly increase the energy density of batteries, while reducing their size and weight. The result? Smaller more powerful batteries that can unlock innovation in consumer devices and accelerate the mass adoption of electric cars to eliminate our dependence on fossil fuels. We're tackling one of the biggest challenges of our time every day, and together we're redefining what's possible. Are you ready to be a part of a team committed to changing the world?

**Who You Are**
---------------



Sila's Program Managers act as the "flight control tower" for our critical, multi\-year integrated programs. This leadership role bridges R\&D, engineering, capital project, and commercial workstreams to ensure complex products scale smoothly from lab to market. You aren't executing the functional tasks—you are orchestrating the sequencing, integration, and high\-stakes decision\-making required to land our strategic objectives safely, on time, and in\-line with target financial metrics.


**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------


* **Integrated Leadership:** Drive major cross\-functional programs linking R\&D (materials/equipment/battery development), Operations (manufacturing), Capital Projects (manufacturing scale\-up), and Product \+ Commercial teams (customer "Plans to Win").
* **Workflow Architect:** Design and communicate workflows to resolve complex uncertainties and decisions. Maintain the "single source of truth" (integrated databases and governance tools) to keep objectives, metrics, and technical data synchronized across functions.
* **Execution \& Sequencing:** Optimize the timing of R\&D breakthroughs, scale\-up projects, and commercial milestones to hit financial and strategic targets (e.g., revenue run rate, ROIC).
* **Executive Communication \& Partnership:** Serve as the central point of accountability for program health, working closely with the Exec Sponsor and Steering Team to steward the program's direction and approach. Deliver crisp status updates, risk assessments, and roadblock resolutions to executives and collaborators. Lead and participate in company\-wide, cross\-program prioritization efforts.
* **Decision \& Risk Management:** Lead execs and functional managers through high\-stakes decisions (e.g., project scoping, partner selection) and proactively mitigate cross\-program dependencies before they impact timelines.

**Knowledge and Skill Requirements**
------------------------------------


* + **Industry Experience:** 10\+ years in battery technology, automotive, chemical process, semiconductor, oil \& gas, or a similarly complex hardware\-plus\-process industry.
	+ **Program Leadership:** 5\+ years leading complex technical and/or business programs that integrate R\&D, manufacturing scale\-up, and commercial execution.
	+ **Scale\-up Expertise:** Proven experience transferring novel technology and/or products from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing environments.
	+ **Education:** Bachelor's degree or higher in an Engineering or Physical Science field.
	+ **Program Management Fundamentals SME:** Deep, demonstrable expertise in core program and project management disciplines—including decision quality, scheduling, budgeting, project framing, financial analysis, risk communication and analysis, and resource allocation.
	+ **Systemic Program Architect:** Proven ability to navigate a matrix model, ensuring functional activities support macro program objectives without duplicating effort.
	+ **Master Communicator:** Skilled at distilling complex technical, financial, and commercial data into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.
	+ **Strategic Influence:** Adept at driving alignment among executives and SMEs, escalating effectively, and balancing technical risks with business objectives.
	+ **New Product Introduction \& Tech Transfer Mastery:** Strong understanding of Stage\-Gate methodologies, with the ability to leverage Agile or Waterfall frameworks depending on the workflow.
	+ **Ambiguity Management:** Comfortable driving execution and maintaining momentum especially in the face of uncertainties, when strategies shift, or deliverables are fluid.

**Physical Demands and Working Conditions**
-------------------------------------------


* Ability to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, lab coats, and steel\-toe shoes when visiting laboratory or manufacturing environments.
* Ability to work at a computer for extended periods.


The starting base pay for this role is between $168,000 and $212,000 at the time of posting. The actual base pay depends on many factors, such as education, experience, and skills. Base pay is only one part of Sila's competitive Total Rewards package that can include benefits, perks, equity, and bonuses. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.



\#LI\-PL1 \#LI\-Onsite



**Working at Sila**
-------------------



We believe that building a diverse team at Sila helps us amplify our individual talents. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment where good ideas are free to come from anyone. We are proud to celebrate diversity and all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, national origin, or any other status protected by law.

Overview:

Shimmick, via our subsidiary Axia Electric, is seeking an experienced and results\-driven **Electrical Project Manager** in Northern California/Bay Area/East Bay region to lead the successful execution of electrical construction projects from contract award through closeout. jobs.title: Data Center Program Manager
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services is seeking a detail oriented, customer obsessed Program Manager for its Infrastructure Operations team.
  

  

Our Program Managers are able to quickly adapt strategies, plans and solutions in response to dynamic business requirements. They also must be comfortable interfacing and driving various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organization. If you have previous project engineering experience, are ready to take on challenges, open minded, appreciate team comradely, have an occasional sense of humor and want to help Amazon raise the bar, then this role is for you!  

  

Successful candidates are natural self\-starters who possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges while driving these solutions to completion. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi\-disciplinary teams (internal operations, engineering, legal, finance, procurement, environmental/health/safety, etc.). This individual has strong communication skills, is organized and thrive in ambiguity.
  

  

The scope of role encompasses program management of capital expense (CAPEX) and/or operational expense (OPEX) projects within data center operations. The scope of projects will include but not be limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection, building improvements, vendor (partner) management, and cluster wide maintenance coordination. An understanding of these systems is necessary, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other teams and organizations.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Manage requirements, budget, design, and implementation of assigned projects  

  

Assess annual maintenance program requirements and build a rolling 18 month project forecast  

  

Facilitate creation of SOWs with partner teams to be included in contract documents including RFQ/RFPs, change order controls, purchase orders, and invoicing.  

  

Evaluate performance and work product of on\-site partners and escalate issues through Amazon leadership.  

  

Identify and communicate needs for design improvements.  

  

Monitor and enforce project schedules and quality with, operational teams, cross functional amazon team members, and partners.  

  

Lead and coordinate design and execution efforts between internal teams and outside partners including equipment specifications, material flow, process design, and site layout.  

  

Evaluate project risks and issues and propose actionable resolutions.  

  

Build strong working relationships with data center leadership teams across multiple sites as well as other internal stakeholders (operations, finance, safety, security, legal, procurement).  

  

General knowledge of data center operations and facility management.  

  

Track record for being detail\-oriented with a demonstrated ability to self\-motivate and follow\-through on projects  

  

Ability to follow accurate and complete support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries.  

  

Proactively and continually improve your level of knowledge about data center relevant technologies.
  

  

About the team  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high\-risk product decisions, often in fast\-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross\-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision\-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross\-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment, strategic foresight, and the ability to operate across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual\-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large\-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject\-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.

* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed.
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow\-through.
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling

* 8\+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust \& safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver high\-pressure, high\-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross\-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs

Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities

Support the Quality Assurance function in maintaining and continuously improving the company’s Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS). Assist with ensuring compliance with applicable GMP, FDA, ICH, and other regulatory requirements.

The QA Associate will support the review and management of GMP documentation, quality events, supplier and CMO oversight, training, and other quality activities. **Quality System**

* Support the implementation and maintenance of the Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS) in accordance with applicable GMP and regulatory requirements.

**Batch Documentation \& QA Review**

* Review GMP documentation, as assigned, for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with approved procedures.

* Support audit and inspection readiness activities.
* Support deviation inspection tracking, CAPA monitoring and change control.
* Support supplier qualification and ongoing monitoring of suppliers. Support the coordination of supplier and CMO audits. Maintain the records.

* Bachelor’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology, or a related discipline.

* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

jobs.description:
Client Services Representative


**Eco Performance Builders** is a well\-established and rapidly growing licensed general, HVAC, and insulation contractor dedicated to enhancing homes for optimal efficiency, comfort, and sustainability. With 14 years of industry experience, we take pride in making existing homes more energy\-efficient and comfortable.

  

We’re looking for an organized, proactive, and personable **Client Services Representative** to become a key part of our client experience and day\-to\-day operations.

  

This is first and foremost a **client service position**. You will often be the first person a prospective or existing client speaks with, so excellent communication, listening skills, professionalism, and attention to detail are essential. The right person will also be self\-directed, comfortable with technology, eager to learn, and interested in understanding the technical aspects of the work we do.

  

Key Responsibilities



Client Service \& Phone Communication


* Serve as the primary person answering our phones and one of the first points of contact for prospective and existing clients. You’ll listen carefully to understand prospective clients' needs, educate them about our services, answer initial questions, and help determine whether our company is a good fit for their project.
* This position involves both **incoming and outbound calls**, so you should enjoy speaking with people and be comfortable initiating conversations. Excellent phone etiquette, a friendly and professional speaking voice, strong listening skills, and attention to detail are important.


Scheduling \& Follow\-Up


* Schedule **sales visits and home walkthroughs** for prospective clients and help coordinate other appointments as needed.
* Follow up with clients at the completion of their projects to ensure they are satisfied and identify any outstanding items that need to be communicated to the appropriate team member.


Software, Systems \& Process Improvement


* You should be **tech\-savvy and eager to learn new software** as our company relies on a variety of software and digital tools to manage clients, projects, scheduling, and communication.
* We also value people who proactively identify opportunities to improve our systems and processes. If you see a way to better organize information, simplify a workflow, or improve how the company operates, we want you to speak up and help make it happen.


Special Projects \& Team Support


* From time to time, you may be asked to assist with projects outside of your normal day\-to\-day responsibilities. * You should be comfortable learning new tasks, taking ownership of assignments, and working independently when given a goal.


Learning Our Business


* We work in a technical industry involving **building science, home performance, HVAC, electrification, insulation, energy efficiency, and indoor air quality**.
* You don't need to arrive as a technical expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn. Over time, we expect you to develop enough understanding of our services to communicate effectively with clients and our technical staff.


Representing the Company


* You should be comfortable speaking with new people, communicating professionally over Zoom, and representing Eco Performance Builders at trade shows, job fairs, community events, and other public\-facing opportunities.


The Person We’re Looking For



The right person for this position is:


* **Organized and detail\-oriented** – You keep track of schedules, conversations, documentation, and follow\-ups without letting details fall through the cracks.
* **A strong communicator and listener** – You have excellent phone etiquette, a professional speaking voice, and communicate clearly and thoughtfully.
* **Proactive and self\-directed** – You don't need someone continually telling you what to do next. You can prioritize your work, stay productive, identify things that need attention, and work independently.
* **Tech\-savvy and eager to learn** – You're comfortable learning new software and interested in finding better ways to use technology and improve company processes.
* **Easygoing and patient** – You work well alongside different personalities and can remain professional and productive during stressful or challenging situations. You don't take personality differences or workplace frustrations personally and focus instead on working together to get the job done.
* **Punctual and dependable** – Your coworkers and our clients can count on you to show up on time and follow through on commitments.
* **A team player** – You're willing to pitch in, communicate openly, and help wherever needed.
* **Solution\-oriented and blame\-free** – When something goes wrong, you focus on solving the problem, learning from it, and moving forward rather than assigning blame or creating unnecessary drama.
* **Flexible** – You're comfortable adjusting when priorities, schedules, or circumstances change.
* **Curious and willing to learn** – You're interested in developing an understanding of building science and the technical aspects of our work.


What Success Looks Like

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Manager, Seller Productivity
jobs.description:
**WHAT IS BOX?**



Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.



By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

  


**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**



The mission of the Global Go to Market (GTM) Enablement team is to empower Box's customer\-facing teams with the knowledge, skills, and tools they need to win. As our **Sales Productivity Manager**, you will sit at the intersection of business strategy, data\-driven skill diagnostics, and modern learning design.



In this role, you will translate strategic company priorities into practical, high\-impact enablement programs for Box Account Executives. Leveraging seller performance data, CRM analytics, and cross\-functional partnerships across Sales, Enablement, and Operations, you will build and execute skills\-based curricula, world\-class onboarding paths, and interactive practice labs. By integrating AI\-first tools and establishing rigorous performance benchmarks, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating ramp time, increasing quota attainment, and driving sustained sales excellence across our global teams.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* **Seller Productivity curriculum design:** Design and deliver role\-specific, skills\-based curriculum for AEs focused on core selling competencies: discovery, qualification, demo delivery, value\-based selling, objection handling, negotiation, and account planning. Design and deliver AE onboarding.
* **Lead live training and coaching:** Facilitate and deliver instructor\-led workshops, virtual skill labs, bootcamps, and reinforcement sessions that emphasize practice, feedback, and behavior change. Design and administer skill assessments and proficiency checks to measure competency and guide coaching.
* **Generate consensus:** Build consensus and momentum across senior, cross\-functional audiences including field leadership and sales operations to diagnose skill gaps using performance metrics, CRM data, call recordings, and seller feedback; prioritize high\-impact skills.
* **Program element creation:** Create short\-form learning assets to support your curriculum: recorded coaching, video role\-plays, microlearning modules, practice scenarios, assessments, and facilitator guides.
* **Program management:** Establish and maintain a training cadence (onboarding, ramp, role progression support, ongoing practice cycles) and ensure consistent delivery across regions and teams managing to timelines, functional priorities, and project plans.
* **Measure:** Define KPIs for training initiatives (ramp time, skill proficiency, call\-to\-demo conversion, win rates where applicable) and iterate curriculum based on data.
* **AI\-First enablement:** Leverage Box AI and modern generative AI tools to 10X the onboarding and sales skills building experience

  

  

**WHO YOU ARE**


* 4\+ years in sales enablement, sales training, or related roles in B2B SaaS with direct experience training quota\-carrying sellers.
* Instructional design instincts: demonstrated success designing and delivering skills\-focused learning that improved seller behaviors and measurable performance outcomes.
* Strong facilitation and coaching skills: comfortable leading live sessions and conducting role\-play–based skills practice.
* Knowledge of sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC/MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger, Command of the Message) and ability to translate methodology into practical seller behaviors.
* Experience using coaching tools and sources of truth for skills diagnostics: call recording platforms, LMS, CRM (Salesforce preferred), and enablement analytics.
* Project and stakeholder management experience; ability to coordinate across a matrixed organization and multiple regions.
* Proven ability to work at AI\-speed, in fast\-paced, matrixed environments
* Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  



Preferred skills


* Experience enabling both new business and expansion/renewal sellers.
* Background in adult learning, instructional design, or certification in relevant fields (ATD, CPLP).
* Experience running sales role\-play programs, certification paths, or coach\-the\-coach initiatives.
* Facilitation, curriculum design for skills practice, behavioral assessment, and data\-driven iteration.

  

  

Success metrics (first 6–12 months)


* Shorter ramp time for new sellers (baseline set in first 30 days).
* Improved proficiency scores on prioritized skills.
* Increased conversion metrics tied to trained skills (e.g., demo\-to\-opportunity).
* High adoption and satisfaction from sellers and managers.

  



Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***


The Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager is a member of the Special Investigations Unit responsible for detecting, validating, and investigating suspected fraudulent activity within the pharmacy benefit — including prescribing, dispensing, and pharmacy claims activity — across a wide range of internal and external data sources. This role centers on rigorous data validation — reconciling, cross\-referencing, and stress\-testing information drawn from numerous systems to confirm accuracy, surface inconsistencies, and build defensible investigative findings.


The ideal candidate pairs a deeply inquisitive, investigative mindset with strong analytical discipline and brings genuine pharmacy depth: fluency with pharmacy claims data and pharmacy benefit operations, including NCPDP claim fields, NDCs, quantity and days supply logic, formulary and prior authorization concepts, and prescriber and pharmacy identifiers (NPI, DEA, state license), together with a working knowledge of the regulatory framework governing pharmacy fraud, waste, and abuse.


They are fluent in recognizing pharmacy fraud triggers and red flags — prescribing and dispensing outliers, controlled substance and overutilization patterns, and pharmacy billing schemes — and they actively leverage AI\-assisted detection and validation tools to scale their analysis, prioritize cases, and reduce false positives. This person is comfortable asking hard questions, following the data wherever it leads, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable conclusions.


In addition to the core responsibilities of the Fraud Program Manager role, this position serves as the primary owner of the CFWA relationship with our pharmacy benefit manager, coordinating referrals, reporting, and oversight activities between the organization and CVS. This person will work side by side with the Fraud Program Manager on overall fraud detection and scheme identification.

***Your responsibilities and impact will include:***

**CFWA Relationship Management — CVS**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for the CFWA program with CVS, managing day\-to\-day coordination, escalations, and information exchange.
* Manage the intake, routing, and disposition of CFWA referrals to and from CVS, tracking each referral through resolution and ensuring turnaround times and documentation standards are met.
* Lead recurring CFWA governance touchpoints (e.g., joint operating and workgroup meetings), setting agendas, tracking action items, and driving issues to closure.
* Review CVS\-provided FWA reporting, investigative summaries, audit results, and recovery activity for completeness, accuracy, and consistency with source claims data; challenge findings that are not supported by the data.
* Monitor CVS performance against contractual, delegated, and regulatory FWA obligations; identify gaps, request corrective action, and escalate deficiencies to compliance and leadership.
* Track pharmacy\-level actions performed by CVS under the PBM agreement — including pharmacy audits, prepayment review, claim edits, recoveries, and network termination — confirming that agreed actions were taken and applied correctly, and escalating where they were not.

**Data Validation \& Source Reconciliation**

* Validate, reconcile, and cross\-reference data drawn from numerous and disparate sources — pharmacy and medical claims systems, PBM data feeds, prior authorization and rejected\-claim data, eligibility and enrollment systems, prescriber and pharmacy provider files, third\-party databases, public records, watchlists, internal applications, and external vendor feeds.
* Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across data sets — including NDC, quantity, days supply, DAW, prescriber NPI, DEA number, and dispensing pharmacy mismatches — and determine whether they indicate error, manipulation, or fraud.
* Establish and maintain data integrity standards for investigations, ensuring findings are accurate, complete, and defensible.
* Trace data lineage across internal systems and PBM\-supplied files, corroborating information against authoritative sources to confirm or refute investigative hypotheses.

**AI\-Assisted Detection \& Validation**

Driven by service design, we strive to know the “Why” to understand the healthcare journey for patients, caregivers, providers, payers, and policymakers.
