jobs.description:
**About MonetizeMore**
----------------------


MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture\-first organization driven by four core values: **Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen** (Continuous Improvement), and **Collaboration**. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

  

**About the Role**
------------------


The company is seeking an experienced, systems\-driven **Business Operations Manager** to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end\-to\-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes.  

  

The **Business Operations Manager** will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross\-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization\-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data\- and AI\-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems.

  

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **1\. Process Kaizen \& SOP Governance**

* ### **Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented.**

### **2\. Project Management \& Visibility**

* ### **Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to\-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company\-wide model with long\-term integration into BL L10s.**

### **3\. Product Rollout Support**

* ### **Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go\-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model.**

### **4\. Cross\-Departmental \& Enterprise Client Enablement**

* ### **Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross\-functional commitments visible and actioned.**

### **5\. Data \& Spreadsheet Management**

* ### **Own data pulls and spreadsheet\-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re\-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental.**


**Who You Are**
---------------

* **The Experienced Operator:** You have 4\+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high\-data\-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC).
* **The Systems Builder:** You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably.
* **Data\- and AI\-Fluent:** You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand\-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work.
* **Comfortable with Ambiguity:** You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.
* **Direct Communicator:** You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **True Flexibility:** Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
* **Professional Development:** Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

This is an ownership role rather than a traditional project support position. You will be accountable for keeping every engagement moving, proactively following up with stakeholders, identifying and resolving blockers, and communicating progress before being asked.



The team supports more than **700 UX Research projects annually**, creating an opportunity to work across a broad portfolio of high value research initiatives while gaining early visibility into products and experiences being developed across the organization. You will join a collaborative and welcoming team where your ability to make an immediate impact is valued.

You are comfortable operating independently in ambiguity, know when to escalate, and remain persistent when progress depends on someone else. jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**The Role:**

JD Power’s Analytics team of over 200 professionals uses a hybrid, customized version of SAFe (scaled agile framework) to coordinate, execute and measure quarterly product development plans through planned cycles (program increments) to deliver value faster and more predictably. This role is responsible for the execution and ongoing optimization of that approach across sets of analytics professionals including data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, data insights analysts, data visualization and QA analysts, and data strategists. You will also interface heavily with partner teams in product and technology organizations as we move towards more consistent approaches across these teams. This is a high\-intensity, high\-visibility execution role involving the creation of net\-new data\-driven, AI\- and ML\-based products with our diverse set of automotive data assets.  



The role also evaluates, reports and conducts retrospectives on Analytics team operational KPIs for several of our major product areas involving our most complex, real\-time data sets that have high customer expectations and very fast customer response times. These metrics involve product quality, throughput, model accuracy and other identifiers. You will partner with Analytics leaders to identify, root cause and improve business performance, and evaluate and measure the impact of use of AI in our development teams.  



This role sits within the Transformation Office, the enterprise function responsible for orchestrating the programs and initiatives that underpin our three\-year strategy. In this capacity, you will be a dedicated execution partner to our CDAO, embedded in the work that matters most and positioned to grow alongside it.  



**The Impact You Will Have in This Role:**

Data and analytics are core to what JD Power sells and how we operate, particularly as our data assets and product development roadmaps have grown more complex and connected across multiple data sources. Your involvement in this position will ensure clarity of product development purpose and enable teams to effectively plan and ultimately own their development commitments. The Project Manager in this role is not a coordinator. You are voice of the Analytics organization in relation to what we shipped, what we will ship, how confident we are in doing so, and whether our quality, throughput and accuracy are performing to expectations.  



**What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:**

· Facilitate program increment quarterly planning events to align teams on a shared mission, objectives and delivery commitments each quarter. Lead inspect \& adapt workshops, facilitating quantitative and qualitative retrospectives and executing on improvement ideas


· Track and communicate metrics like completion rates, program predictability, to provide transparency and drive continuous improvement


· Leading end\-to\-end program delivery by coordinating across multiple teams and functions, adapting to methodologies as needed including Agile, hybrid, and data platform\-specific workflows


· Building, maintaining, and owning the committed project plan and schedule, distinct from the product roadmap, and ensuring milestones are met with transparency and rigor


· Drive adoption and maturity of product planning practices across the organization


· Applying a hybrid toolkit – technical project management, agile delivery, and business analysis to address the specific needs of each workstream


· Bring technical project management expertise to address engineering and AI challenges, working closely with technical leads and data scientists to monitor development progress and ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution.


· Partner with Analytics leaders to set annual KPI objectives for year\-on\-year improvements. Proactively measure and report out on those KPIs and partner with technical teams to uncover root causes, implement retrospective actions and identify risks and countermeasures  



**What You Bring**

· 5\-8 years of project management experience


· Highly accountable, you own your commitments, follow through without being chased, and hold others to the same standard


· A self\-starter who can operate with limited direction, identify what needs to happen next, and move without waiting to be told


· Strong communication skills, able to distill complex program status into clear, concise updates for leadership audiences, both written and verbal


· Experience in technology\-centric environments (software development, IT, or data) with a history of bridging business objectives and technical execution


· Proficiency in SAFe a plus. Proficiency in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, generally speaking; experience with Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar SDLC and PM tools


· Demonstrated experience applying AI tools to program and project management workflows, and a track record of proactively exploring and adopting emerging AI capabilities to improve team productivity and decision\-making


· Strong RAID discipline, schedule management, budget oversight, and the instinct to track details without losing sight of the bigger picture.


· Comfortable managing multiple workstreams concurrently in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment


· Bachelor's degree preferred; PMP certification a plus


· North American based, with availability to work across a distributed global team.  



This position has a starting salary range of **$75,000 – $90,000 USD / 75,000 – 123,000 CAD** per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Project Manager (SaaS Implementations)
jobs.description:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed \& Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.


Bullhorn is a fast\-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.


**About the role**

The **Project Manager** is a key position within Professional Services and the PMO and acts with integrity and leads by example, serving as the primary point of contact throughout the customer engagement lifecycle. This role is accountable for ensuring the right resources, governance, and methodologies are in place to enable successful planning, execution, and delivery of complex core SaaS system implementations for our clients, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, on budget, and with high CSAT scores.


In this capacity, the Project Manager partners closely with Customers, Sales Executives, Solution Consultants, Solution Architects, and Software Engineers to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and deliverables align with defined success criteria. By applying project management best practices and adhering to Bullhorn’s PMO processes, the Senior Project Manager defines, drives, and manages the delivery of projects, managing scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and stakeholder expectations to ensure an exceptional customer experience from project initiation through closure.  

  



**A typical day will include...**
---------------------------------

* **Owning the Project Lifecycle:** Lead the planning, execution, and closure of multiple, concurrent, large\-scale client software implementation projects, establishing the necessary governance and structure where none exists.
* **Proactively Drive Clarity and Order:** Quickly assess and gain command over complex, ambiguous, and high\-risk projects, translating chaos into defined, manageable, and executable project plans.
* **Ultimate Accountability:** Serve as the single point of accountability for project status and success. Naturally take ownership of problems and aggressively drive solutions to resolution.
* **Rigorous Risk and Scope Management:** Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks, dependencies, and issues. Firmly manage scope creep and hold both internal and client stakeholders accountable to agreed\-upon project plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Executive\-Level Communicatio** n: Manage client and vendor relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for project status, expectations, and issue resolution with executive and C\-level stakeholders.
* **Financial and Resource Control:** Oversee project budgets, tracking hours and expenses to ensure financial targets are met and providing accurate, predictable and insightful forecasting and reporting.
* **Methodology Adherence:** Apply project management best practices and actively contribute to the development, improvement and standardization of Bullhorn's PMO processes.
* Mentoring and provide guidance to junior project managers or implementation specialists on best practices and project governance.

**This role is a fit for you if...**
------------------------------------

* Have 3\+ years of progressive experience managing complex, external client\-facing software implementation projects, with a significant focus on ERP, HCM, CRM, or large\-scale SaaS solutions with billable utilization targets.
* A proven track record of successfully delivering projects that have a high level of complexity and ambiguity, demonstrating the ability to rapidly impose structure and governance.
* An expertise in defining and managing project scope, schedules, and budgets for large enterprise clients.
* A mastery of various project management methodologies ( *e.g.,* Waterfall, Scrum, Hybrid) and knowing when to apply each to achieve stability.
* A solid understanding of the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, configuration, data migration, integration, testing (UAT), and go\-live.
* Have a proficiency with modern project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, SmartSheet) and resource management systems.
* PMP, CSM, or equivalent is highly preferred.

The annual base salary range for this position is $92,002 \- $115,000\. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual target bonus \& a comprehensive benefits package.


**Compensation and Transparency Statement**

The posted range represents the good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual pay within the range will be based on factors such as, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business or organizational needs and affordability. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request

As the Task Order (TO) Project Manager for the Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI) Strategic Planning Division (SPD) support contract, you will serve as the primary interface with the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) and lead all aspects of program and project management support for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). Operating within VA's federal healthcare environment under the Strategic Planning Division's innovation engine within Planning, Innovation \& Modernization (PIM), you will oversee the planning, execution, tracking, and reporting of task order deliverables to ensure mission\-aligned outcomes that directly support Veterans' care and benefits programs of data\-driven and value\-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden.
  
  

The ideal candidate is a disciplined, results\-oriented project management professional who thrives in complex federal healthcare environments, communicates with clarity at the executive level, and proactively manages risk, schedules, and stakeholder relationships with minimal direction.
  
  

**Primary Responsibilities:**  

Serve as the single, authoritative point of contact for all COR communications, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional responses to Government inquiries, direction, and feedback throughout the life of the task order.
  
  

Develop, maintain, and report on comprehensive project management artifacts including project plans, integrated master schedules (IMS), risk registers, and status reports in compliance with VA and federal contracting standards.
  
  

Produce and deliver executive\-level program management deliverables, including briefings, dashboards, monthly status reports, and milestone reviews, tailored for senior VA leadership and Government stakeholders.
  
  

Lead internal team coordination and cross\-functional collaboration to ensure all task order workstreams remain on schedule, within scope, and aligned to contract performance requirements and PWS objectives.
  
  

Identify, assess, and manage program risks and issues; develop mitigation strategies and escalate critical items to the COR and company leadership in a timely and structured manner.
  
  

Report to the VA Central Office at 810 Vermont Ave NW, Washington, DC upon Government request, supporting on\-site meetings, reviews, and engagements without charging travel expenses to the Government.
  
  

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

Minimum of 4 years of federal healthcare program and/or project management experience, with a demonstrated track record of managing multi\-workstream task orders or contracts within a federal agency environment.
  
  

Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) from an accredited institution required; Project Management Professional (PMP) certification through PMI is required and must be active and in good standing at time of hire.
  
  

Demonstrated experience supporting or working directly with federal healthcare agencies (e.g., VA, DoD/DoW, HHS, CMS), including familiarity with federal contracting vehicles, COR relationships, and Government program oversight processes.
  
  

Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and satisfy all applicable VA background investigation and suitability requirements prior to performing work.
  
  

Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not offer visa sponsorship.
  
  

Must reside within reasonable commuting distance of VA Central Office at 810 Vermont Ave NW, Washington, DC and be available to report on\-site at the Government's request without travel reimbursement from the Government.
  
  

**Desired Qualifications:**  

* Prior VA\-specific program management experience, particularly supporting VA Central Office (VACO) initiatives, the Office of Community Care, or VA healthcare transformation programs such as CCPI or related and value\-based health care solutions or innovation efforts. • Familiarity with development of VA data\-driven and value\-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden and/or connecting pilot design, resourcing, evaluation, strategic planning, and enterprise decision\-making. • Experience managing deliverables under federal Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts and producing compliant Program Management Reviews (PMRs) or Integrated Baseline Reviews (IBRs). • Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent scheduling and reporting platforms used in federal program environments. • Advanced degree (MBA, MPA, or MS in a related field) or additional certifications such as FAC\-P/PM, PgMP, or a Lean/Agile credential applicable to federal healthcare delivery.

**Requisition ID: 2026\-4642 Job Summary:**  

As a Pilot Project Manager supporting the VA's Chief Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI) office within the Strategic Planning Division (SPD) innovation engine aligned with VA Planning, Innovation \& Modernization (PIM), you will lead the planning, execution, and performance tracking of healthcare pilot and innovation programs designed to improve Veterans' health outcomes and care delivery across VA facilities. This role operates at the intersection of federal healthcare policy and operational innovation, requiring close collaboration with VA program offices, senior executive stakeholders, and Congressional reporting chains to advance high\-visibility transformation initiatives.
  
  

The ideal candidate is a disciplined, detail\-oriented project manager who thrives in complex, ambiguous federal healthcare environments and can translate program performance data into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership and legislative audiences, especially with regard to the development of data\-driven and value\-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden.
  
  

**Primary Responsibilities:**  

Lead end\-to\-end project management of VA healthcare pilot and innovation efforts, including scope definition, work planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and stakeholder coordination across program lifecycle phases.
  
  

Develop, maintain, and deliver high\-quality performance reports and program dashboards tailored for Senior Executive Service (SES) review, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with VA strategic priorities.
  
  

Support the preparation of Congressional reporting packages, briefing materials, and responses to data calls, ensuring compliance with federal reporting standards and legislative requirements.
  
  

Facilitate cross\-functional working groups and pilot site coordination meetings, capturing action items, decisions, and risks while driving accountability among internal and external stakeholders.
  
  

Monitor and evaluate pilot program performance metrics against defined success criteria, identifying trends, gaps, and opportunities for course correction or scale\-up recommendations.
  
  

Maintain comprehensive project documentation including charters, schedules, risk registers, lessons\-learned logs, and after\-action reports in accordance with federal contracting and VA documentation standards.
  
  

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

Minimum 4 years of project management experience, with demonstrated experience managing healthcare pilot programs, innovation initiatives, or similarly complex multi\-stakeholder engagements.
  
  

Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in Public Health, Health Administration, Business Administration, Public Policy, or a related field required.
  
  

Prior experience supporting federal agency clients, VA program offices, or federal healthcare environments strongly preferred; familiarity with VA organizational structure and mission is highly desirable.
  
  

Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and pass a VA background investigation; active clearance or prior federal suitability determination is a plus.
  
  

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship; this position supports a federal government contract and is subject to applicable federal employment eligibility requirements.
  
  

Demonstrated experience developing performance reports, briefing materials, or data packages for senior government leaders (SES\-level or equivalent) and/or Congressional stakeholders.
  
  

**Desired Qualifications:**  

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is strongly preferred. \| \- Experience with VA or federal health innovation offices (e.g., VHA Innovation Ecosystem, CMMI, CMTO, or equivalent) is a significant plus. \| \- Familiarity with federal performance management frameworks such as GPRAMA, OMB reporting requirements, or VA MISSION Act implementation. \| \- Experience using VA\-approved collaboration and project tracking tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, SharePoint, Teams, or equivalent federal\-compliant platforms). \| \- Prior experience coordinating Congressional data calls, GAO engagements, or IG responses in a federal healthcare contracting context.

jobs.title: Infusion Intake Coordinator
jobs.description:
Infusion Intake Coordinator

We are seeking an experienced Infusion Intake Coordinator with a strong background in infusion therapy and specialty medications. This role is responsible for managing infusion referrals from intake through scheduling readiness, ensuring patients move efficiently and accurately from referral to treatment.

The ideal candidate understands the referral lifecycle, payer requirements, and the day to day coordination needed to keep infusion referrals on track.

This position may be remote or in\-person depending on experience and fit.

Compensation

**$65,000–$85,000 per year, depending on experience**

Requirements

* Minimum 2 years of infusion experience required
* Direct experience with:
* Infusion intake
* Prior authorizations
* Benefits verification
* Medicare Part B buy\-and\-bill
* Medicare Part D / specialty pharmacy workflows
* Commercial and Medicare insurance plans
* Coordination with provider offices and patients
* Understanding of infusion workflows across specialties such as neurology, rheumatology, gastroenterology, immunology, and more
* Ability to identify and flag issues that could delay patient treatment
* Highly organized with strong follow through and attention to detail
* Comfortable managing multiple active referrals and cases simultaneously in a fast paced environment

Preferred Experience

* Ambulatory infusion center or physician office infusion experience
* WeInfuse experience preferred
* Familiarity with 340B programs and specialty pharmacy coordination
* Familiarity with buy and bill infusion operations
* Working knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD\-10, and infusion authorization workflows

Responsibilities

* Process incoming infusion referrals from intake through scheduling readiness
* Review physician orders, diagnoses, clinical documentation, and insurance information for accuracy and completeness
* Coordinate with provider offices to obtain missing documentation or clarify orders when needed
* Initiate and track benefits investigations, prior authorizations, and financial clearance requirements
* Navigate both buy and bill and specialty pharmacy referral pathways appropriately
* Track referral status and follow up on outstanding documentation, authorizations, and payer requirements
* Flag reimbursement, site\-of\-care, or payer\-related issues that may impact treatment initiation
* Serve as a liaison between patients, referral sources, specialty pharmacies, payers, and internal clinical/RCM teams
* Maintain accurate documentation within EMR and operational systems
* Ensure intake work remains compliant with HIPAA and internal documentation standards
* Follow established intake workflows and SOPs, and suggest improvements as needed
* Work closely with authorization, scheduling, clinical, and billing departments to ensure timely treatment initiation and continuity of care

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the referral process from beginning to end. The right candidate is proactive, resourceful, and understands what needs to happen to move a patient from referral to treatment.

This person should be comfortable managing a busy referral pipeline, identifying what is holding up a case, following up with the appropriate party, and keeping referrals moving without needing constant direction.

We value someone who communicates well with patients and provider offices, stays on top of outstanding items, and understands the importance of getting patients cleared and scheduled as efficiently as possible.

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Please describe your infusion experience, including your experience with infusion intake, benefits verification, prior authorizations, buy\-and\-bill medications, and specialty pharmacy workflows.

Work Location: Remote

**About the job**

This role is central to keeping our hiring process running smoothly and ensuring our people\-related administrative processes are handled accurately, promptly, and with discretion. From the mountains to the coast, from large cities to small towns, Community Care of North Carolina is transforming health care. To improve the health and quality of life for all North Carolinians by building supporting better community\-based healthcare delivery systems.

The Call Center Coordinator is responsible for telephonic outreach and screening of identified members based on plan stratification for care management with a call center approach. Call Center staff also monitor for incoming calls, process referrals, and assist with any questions or needs identified. An experienced and energetic communicator, the coordinator is focused on deepening program participation as well as making members aware of CCNC (plan) programs and offerings.

  

The Call Center Coordinator interacts with members, providers, and other staff to initiate program interventions, document activities, and refer risk appropriate members to professional staff according to protocols. You ask the questions others miss. You explore for fun, not just for work \- and it shows in the quality of your thinking.

 **What You'll Do**



The Account Manager is responsible for owning the full post\-sale lifecycle for a set of customers from the moment they sign through their renewal. This role blends onboarding ownership with long\-term account management. You will guide customers through setup, launch, early adoption, and ongoing success, ensuring they achieve fast time\-to\-value and remain successful and retained customers.


You will run structured onboarding for the first 60 days, then continue as the primary relationship manager responsible for adoption, sentiment, value realization, renewal readiness, and churn prevention. You will identify risks early, build multi\-threaded relationships, run health reviews, and execute a consistent renewal playbook. This is a hands\-on role for someone who loves helping customers win, shaping process, and driving measurable retention outcomes.



**Key Responsibilities**


**Customer Onboarding Ownership (First 60 Days)**


* Act as the single\-threaded owner for every new customer during onboarding.
* Run kickoff calls, define success criteria, align on use cases, and ensure a clean sales\-to\-onboarding handoff.
* Guide customers through setup, integrations, configuration, and go\-live.
* Manage timelines, remove blockers, and keep customers moving to activation.
* Teach users how to use Zocks with live trainings, walkthroughs, and simple enablement content.
* Ensure a smooth post\-onboarding transition while staying on as the ongoing account owner.

  


**Adoption and Value Realization**


* Drive user activation and usage across key product features.
* Monitor customer engagement signals including meeting volume, utilization, integration completion, and workflow setup.
* Run scheduled check\-ins to reinforce value, highlight wins, and review progress.
* Build repeatable playbooks for increasing adoption and correcting early usage gaps.
* Partner with Product and RevOps to share insights on customer needs and feature impact.


**Churn Prevention and Account Health**
* Own Gross ARR Retention and renewal outcomes for your book of business.
* Maintain clear visibility into account health using dashboards, health scores, and engagement metrics.
* Identify churn risks early and execute save plays including sentiment resets, retraining, and workflow redesign.
* Document risks and escalate where necessary with clear recommended actions.
* Ensure ongoing alignment with customer goals and continuously reinforce ROI.


**Renewal Management (120 days leading up to renewal)**
* Own renewal preparation, forecasting accuracy, and timely execution.
* Run structured renewal processes including usage reviews, performance summaries, and value recap meetings.
* Confirm contract terms, seat counts, and pricing ahead of renewal cycles.
* Manage renewal negotiations directly with customers and ensure renewal approval happens on time.
* Maintain renewal documentation in Salesforce with clean, complete data.


**Cross\-Functional Alignment**
* Partner with Sales to ensure a smooth handoff at contract signature and clarity on success outcomes.
* Work with Product on implementation feedback, customer asks, and adoption blockers.
* Collaborate with RevOps to improve onboarding and retention reporting, health scoring, and automation.
* Work with Support for escalations and ensure customers understand engagement paths after onboarding.
  


**Operational Excellence**
* Document customer configurations, onboarding progress, known risks, and adoption milestones.
* Update onboarding and renewal playbooks based on learnings and patterns from your accounts.
* Identify opportunities for automation or simplification in workflows, templates, and customer communication.
* Own accuracy and upkeep of notes, tasks, and renewal data across Salesforce and internal tools.


**What We're Looking For**
**Requirements**
* 2 to 5 plus years in Account Management, Customer Success, or Onboarding at a B2B SaaS company.
* Experience in wealth\-tech, fintech, or regulated SaaS.
* Proven success driving fast time\-to\-value and strong renewals.
* Strong communication skills and confidence leading customer\-facing calls.

jobs.title: Capability and Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**
===============


Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no\-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.


People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like\-minded people driving change at Howden.


What is the role?

  

We are seeking a Capability and Enablement Lead with a remote work schedule.

 **ROLE SUMMARY**


We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Capability and Enablement Lead to design and deliver role‑based learning and operational enablement that ensures consistent adoption of processes, systems, and ways of working across US Retail Operations and Client Servicing.

  

Reporting to the Head of Continuous Improvement \& Change, this role is accountable for translating future‑state processes and operating models into clear, practical, and measurable learning experiences that enable colleagues to perform effectively in the new environment. The role partners closely with Process Excellence, PMO, Operations, and Technology, while retaining primary ownership of instructional design, learning strategy, and capability outcomes.

  

This is a hands‑on instructional design and enablement leadership role — focused on building operational capability.

  

What will you be doing?

 **Learning Strategy and Instructional Design**

* Own the enablement and learning strategy for Operations and Client Servicing, aligned to the target operating model and process standards.
* Design modular, role‑based curricula grounded in adult learning theory and instructional design best practices.
* Translate SOPs, process maps, and system changes into clear performance‑based learning objectives.
* Define learning pathways that support onboarding, role transitions, and ongoing proficiency.
  

Content Development and Knowledge Enablement

* Design and maintain high‑quality learning assets including job aids, playbooks, e‑learning modules, simulations, and facilitator guides.
* Partner with SMEs and Operations leaders to validate accuracy and usability of learning content.
* Build and maintain a centralized knowledge repository to support self‑service and point‑of‑need learning.
 **Learning Delivery and Reinforcement**

* Support delivery of learning through blended approaches (virtual, in‑person, on‑the‑job), leveraging Operations leaders and SMEs as facilitators where appropriate.
* Design reinforcement mechanisms (refreshers, quick references, embedded learning) to support sustained adoption.
* Gather learner feedback and continuously refine content and delivery methods.
 **Measurement \& Continuous Improvement**

* Define and track learning effectiveness using operational KPIs (accuracy, cycle time, quality, compliance).
* Partner with Operations to identify capability gaps and update learning accordingly.
* Use data to demonstrate impact of learning on performance and adoption.
  

Partnership \& Adoption Support

* Partner with Process Excellence to ensure processes and SOPs are adoption‑ready and supported by appropriate learning.
* Partner with PMO and Program Managers to align enablement timing with delivery milestones.
* Support change adoption through learning and performance enablement — not ownership of enterprise change frameworks.
  

Key Skills \& Competencies

* Deep expertise in instructional design and adult learning principles.
* Strong ability to translate complex operational processes into clear, role‑based learning.
* Experience designing learning that drives measurable performance outcomes.
* Strong collaboration skills across Operations, Process, Technology, and PMO.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to assess learning impact using operational data.
  

What are we looking for?

 **Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of experience in Learning \& Development, Operations Enablement, or Process Training within an insurance brokerage or related financial services environment
* Strong understanding of brokerage operations, systems (e.g., Epic or other AMS), and workflows (e.g., billing, certificates, policy administration, claims)
* Proven ability to design and deliver training programs that improve operational performance and adoption
* Experience collaborating with Operations, IT, and Change teams to align training with business initiatives
* Proficiency in instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and modern learning delivery methods (virtual, e\-learning, and in\-person)
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable learning content
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Education, Operations, Organizational Development, or a related field preferred (or equivalent experience)

* Familiarity with e\-learning tools and Learning Management Systems (LMS) administration and content tracking is a plus

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**


Adeptus Solutions, Inc. is seeking a Business Analyst to support technology and software development initiatives within a SAFe Agile environment. The Business Analyst will work closely with stakeholders, Product Management, developers, QA, Scrum Masters, and project leadership to understand business needs, analyze processes, capture business rules, and translate requirements into actionable Agile work items in Azure DevOps (ADO).
The ideal candidate can bridge the gap between business and technical teams by turning complex business processes and requirements into clear, testable, and traceable features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Elicit, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Map and document current\-state and future\-state business processes, including workflows, decision points, actors, system interactions, and dependencies.
* Identify, document, and maintain business rules, policies, conditions, and system behaviors that govern business processes.
* Translate business requirements, process models, and business rules into SAFe/Agile features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and ADO work items.
* Create and maintain requirements in Azure DevOps (ADO) and ensure work items accurately reflect approved business needs and scope.
* Decompose complex requirements into appropriately sized, actionable user stories that can be developed and tested within an iteration.
* Develop clear, measurable, and testable acceptance criteria that define expected system behavior and business outcomes.
* Maintain requirements traceability from business needs and business rules through features, user stories, development, testing, and acceptance.
* Collaborate with Product Management and Product Owners to support backlog development, prioritization, refinement, and readiness.
* Participate in SAFe PI Planning, backlog refinement, iteration planning, system demos, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and working sessions with business and technical stakeholders.
* Analyze requirements and processes to identify gaps, inconsistencies, dependencies, risks, and impacts.
* Work directly with developers and technical teams to clarify requirements, business rules, workflows, and expected system behavior.
* Partner with QA to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria provide a sufficient basis for test planning and validation.
* Review proposed solutions and developed functionality to verify alignment with approved requirements and business processes.
* Analyze proposed changes and document their impact on requirements, processes, functionality, scope, and downstream systems.
* Develop and maintain process flows, workflow diagrams, business rules catalogs, functional requirements, requirements traceability matrices, and other BA artifacts.
* Ensure requirements and supporting documentation remain current and synchronized with ADO and the approved product backlog.
* Identify and communicate requirements\-related risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Support continuous improvement of business analysis, requirements management, and Agile delivery practices.

  

**Skills and Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related field, and four years of experience as a Business Analyst or related role.
* Demonstrated experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements, technical requirements, and business rules.
* Experience developing current\-state and future\-state process maps and documenting business workflows.
* Experience translating requirements and process analysis into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and Agile work items.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) or a comparable requirements and Agile work\-management platform.
* Experience working within a SAFe Agile and/or Agile/Scrum environment.
* Understanding of software development lifecycles and the relationship between requirements, development, QA, deployment, and operational support.
* Strong understanding of requirements traceability and requirements management.
* Ability to analyze complex business processes and translate them into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate with business stakeholders, Product Management, Product Owners, developers, QA, Scrum Masters, and project leadership.
* Experience with process modeling and diagramming tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or similar platforms.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud technologies, APIs, system integrations, databases, data flows, or technical architectures is preferred.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAFe certification or demonstrated experience working within a SAFe Agile Release Train (ART).
* Experience supporting PI Planning and iteration planning.
* Experience managing and refining product backlogs in ADO.
* Experience developing business rules, process models, requirements traceability, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working directly with software development and QA teams.
* Experience with complex technical systems, integrations, APIs, data flows, or cloud\-based applications.
* Agile, SAFe, Scrum, ITIL, PMP, or related certification.

jobs.title: Lead, Channel Enablement
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**

‎


Commercial Organization \| GTM Enablement
  

Reports to: Director, GTM Enablement
  

  

The Lead, Channel Enablement owns the enablement strategy and infrastructure that helps Castlight\-powered solutions get sold effectively through our channel ecosystem, including health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace relationships.
  

  

This role is the Commercial owner of the second sale enablement motion and the connective tissue across Castlight, our partners, and the teams responsible for bringing our solutions to market. The Lead builds the training, demos, tools, and repeatable programs that allow partner sellers and Castlight teams to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Castlight\-powered solutions at scale.
  

  

The role also owns the core demo infrastructure supporting channel selling, ensuring our Figma environments, screen libraries, and partner\-specific experiences stay current as the product evolves.
‎


**How will you make an impact \& Requirements**

‎


**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Channel \& Partner Enablement**
---------------------------------

* Build and own the channel enablement strategy across health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace partners.
* Develop scalable enablement programs that help partner sellers understand the buyer problem, articulate the Castlight value proposition, demonstrate the solution, and advance opportunities.
* Create partner\-ready training programs, playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, objection handling, templates, and selling tools using Product Marketing's approved positioning and messaging.
* Partner with Strategic Partnerships to build tailored enablement programs based on partner type, commercial model, seller audience, and go\-to\-market motion.
* Support the launch and ongoing readiness of new partner relationships and Castlight\-powered offerings.

**Second Sale Enablement**
--------------------------

* Own the enablement framework for the second sale motion across health plan and partner channels.
* Establish one source of truth for second sale training, demos, tools, templates, and selling standards.
* Prepare Castlight Commercial and Client teams for the transition of second sale execution to Client CSMs by September 30\.
* Build repeatable training and certification approaches that allow Client teams to execute consistently while maintaining Commercial standards.
* Create scalable processes for Commercial review, feedback, and continuous improvement as execution moves closer to the client and health plan teams.

**Demo Strategy \& Engineering**
--------------------------------

* Own the core demo environments supporting health plan, partner, reseller, and second sale motions.
* Build and maintain Figma\-based demos, screen libraries, reusable components, and partner\-specific demo experiences.
* Maintain demo environments as products, capabilities, positioning, and user experiences evolve.
* Lead Nova conversions across the existing channel book and establish the standards for new partner implementations.
* Manage partner access to demo environments and establish clear governance around version control, usage, and updates.
* Coordinate external design or Figma resources as needed to maintain and scale the demo platform.
* Establish a regular operating cadence with Product, UX, Solutions, and Product Marketing so demo experiences remain accurate and current.

**Cross\-Functional Enablement**
--------------------------------

* Translate Product Marketing's positioning and messaging into usable seller training, demos, and field tools.
* Partner with Strategic Partnerships to understand partner priorities, seller needs, and commercial opportunities.
* Partner with Client leadership to ensure second sale teams have the tools, training, and confidence required to execute.
* Partner with Solutions and Product teams to keep demonstrations accurate and identify opportunities to improve how Castlight capabilities are represented in market.
* Bring health plan, partner, seller, and field feedback back to Product Marketing, Product, Solutions, and Strategic Partnerships to improve messaging, products, and the partner experience.

**How Ownership Works**
-----------------------

This role operates across several teams, with clear ownership boundaries:


**Product Marketing** owns core positioning, messaging architecture, value propositions, competitive strategy, and master marketing assets.


**Channel Enablement** turns that strategy into training, demos, playbooks, tools, certification, and scalable seller experiences.


**Strategic Partnerships** owns partner strategy, relationships, commercial agreements, partner performance, and escalations.


**Client CSMs** own plan\-specific second sale execution, including training delivery to health plan sellers and ongoing maintenance of client\-specific materials.


**Solutions and Product** provide product expertise, roadmap input, and validation required to keep demonstrations technically accurate.


**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Partner sellers can confidently explain and demonstrate Castlight\-powered solutions without relying on Castlight for every selling interaction.
* Health plan and partner channels have consistent, current, easy\-to\-use enablement resources.
* Second sale execution successfully transitions to Client teams without losing quality or commercial consistency.
* Demo environments stay aligned with the live product and can be efficiently adapted across partners and channels.
* New partners can move from agreement to seller readiness through a repeatable enablement process.
* Feedback from partner and second sale motions consistently reaches the teams responsible for product, messaging, and commercial strategy.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 4\+ years of experience in sales enablement, partner enablement, solutions consulting, product marketing su

new_jobs.title: Office Manager, San Francisco
new_jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go\-to\-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1\.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

**About the Role**
------------------



Apollo is opening a new office in San Francisco, and we're looking for an Office Manager to own the day\-to\-day operations of the space. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, this person will make sure the office is safe, welcoming, and productive, from front\-of\-house hospitality to vendor coordination to onboarding logistics.



This role is about more than keeping the lights on. You will bring structure and follow\-through to a growing office, working closely with the Chief of Staff, IT Team, and People Team to keep operations running smoothly as the team scales. You will set the tone for anyone who walks through the door, whether that is a new hire on day one or a visiting executive.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail oriented, and genuinely enjoys creating a great workplace experience. You are just as comfortable managing vendors and logistics as you are greeting a visitor with a warm welcome.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Office Operations \& Vendor Management**


* Support the day\-to\-day operations of the office environment to ensure it remains safe, welcoming, and productive.
* Collaborate with the Chief of Staff to implement office policies, coordinate logistics, and support company initiatives.
* Coordinate with building management and approved vendors, including maintenance, cleaning, snacks, and supplies, under guidance from the Chief of Staff.
* Maintain inventory of office supplies and oversee restocking of all common areas.
* Report and follow up on facility maintenance issues, working closely with building management and approved vendors. Obtain a minimum of three invoices or quotes per service, per policy.
* Coordinate vendors and contractors end to end: schedule the work, follow through, and catch issues before they become visible problems.

### **Workplace Experience, Onboarding \& Events**


* Greet visitors and ensure a smooth check\-in experience that reflects Apollo's brand and hospitality standards.
* Manage badge and access administration, including access for visitors, card deactivation, and a monthly review of active access cards.
* Own onsite onboarding activities and office onboarding logistics in collaboration with IT and People Ops, including welcome and orientation touchpoints.
* Help coordinate in\-office events, employee recognition moments, and team gatherings with direction from the Chief of Staff.
* Maintain organization and daily presentation of communal spaces such as kitchens, conference rooms, and shared desks.

### **Health, Safety \& Compliance**


* Assist in safety procedures and help coordinate office readiness, such as fire drills and ergonomic checks.
* Ensure signage, office protocols, and emergency materials are maintained and up to date.
* Act as a point of contact during minor incidents or office\-related disruptions, escalating appropriately to building management and leadership.
* Work closely with Apollo's safety and compliance stakeholders on any office\-related safety requests.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------



In this role, success means:


* The office runs smoothly day to day, and issues are resolved before they become disruptions.
* Vendors and building management are handled proactively, with clear documentation and cost discipline.
* New hires have a welcoming first day, and visitors leave with a strong impression of Apollo.
* The Chief of Staff, IT, and People Team all consider this person a reliable partner.
* Office events and team moments feel organized and well executed.
* Safety protocols and compliance requirements are consistently met.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* 3 to 5 years of experience in administrative, office management, workplace operations, hospitality, or facilities coordination roles.
* Experience supporting an in\-office team in a startup or corporate environment.
* **Organization:** Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple requests at once.
* **Communication:** Clear, friendly communication style, written and verbal, with a service\-oriented, hospitality mindset.
* **Follow\-through:** Proven ability to follow processes, stay on top of logistical details, and own assigned responsibilities.
* **Vendor management:** Working knowledge of vendor coordination, invoices, and budget review.
* Comfortable using tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, calendar management software, and ticketing or help desk platforms.
* Comfortable using AI tools to boost day\-to\-day productivity, such as drafting and summarizing, and able to critically assess AI\-generated content.
* Full\-time, on\-site availability in San Francisco, five days a week.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------



You may be a strong fit if you are:


* Someone who sets a warm, professional tone for anyone entering the office.
* Proactive and solutions\-focused, comfortable anticipating needs in a fast\-paced, changing environment.

**The Role:**

JD Power’s Analytics team of over 200 professionals uses a hybrid, customized version of SAFe (scaled agile framework) to coordinate, execute and measure quarterly product development plans through planned cycles (program increments) to deliver value faster and more predictably. This role is responsible for the execution and ongoing optimization of that approach across sets of analytics professionals including data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, data insights analysts, data visualization and QA analysts, and data strategists. The role also evaluates, reports and conducts retrospectives on Analytics team operational KPIs for several of our major product areas involving our most complex, real\-time data sets that have high customer expectations and very fast customer response times. These metrics involve product quality, throughput, model accuracy and other identifiers. · North American based, with availability to work across a distributed global team.

* General office demands. This is a remote position that requires regular use of a computer, participation in video and telephone meetings, and the ability to manage detailed work across multiple systems and deadlines.

**National Accounts Manager – Food Service**

***Job Details***  
Job Type: Full\-time  
Salary: $75,000 plus commission

***Job Summary***  
Homecrest Outdoor Living is seeking a high\-performing sales leader to launch and grow our national Food Service \& Restaurant division while expanding our Dock Furniture Program. This executive\-level business development role will establish strategic partnerships with premium restaurant groups, hospitality operators, food service management companies, architects, designers, purchasing organizations, and ownership groups. The manager will build a new national sales channel while positioning Homecrest as the preferred manufacturer of premium commercial outdoor furniture.

This position offers the rare opportunity to build a new national business segment with executive visibility, meaningful autonomy, and significant long\-term growth potential. The successful candidate will help shape the future of Homecrest's commercial division while working alongside an experienced leadership team committed to innovation, quality, and customer success.

***Job Duties***

· Develop and execute the national business strategy for the Food Service \& Restaurant division.

· Acquire and grow regional and national restaurant accounts through direct selling.

· Build executive relationships with ownership, procurement, A\&D firms, food service consultants, and hospitality leaders.

· Generate specifications for new construction, renovations, rooftop dining, and patio dining.

· Manage strategic accounts from prospecting through implementation and repeat business.

· Maintain a healthy CRM pipeline, forecast sales, and deliver revenue and profitability goals.

· Represent Homecrest at the National Restaurant Association Show and other industry events.

· Partner with marketing, product development, operations, customer service, and manufacturing to ensure exceptional customer experiences.

· Develop and implement a selling strategy for Homecrest’s Dock Furniture Program.

· Collaborate with dock manufacturers to develop integrated outdoor living solutions that complement dock systems.

***Requirements***

· Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, hospitality, or related discipline preferred.

· 5\+ years of success selling to national accounts in Food Service.

· Experience in selling to hospitality and A\&D markets is a plus.

· Proven ability to develop new business and close complex, multi\-location opportunities.

· Excellent presentation, negotiation, communication, and relationship\-building skills.

· Willingness to travel nationally approximately 40–60% of the time.

***What Success Looks Like***

· Become the trusted outdoor furniture partner for premier restaurant and hospitality brands.

· Develop a sustainable national pipeline that produces long\-term recurring revenue.

· Expand Homecrest's market presence within the premium food service segment.

· Drive profitable growth while strengthening the Homecrest brand nationwide.

***Benefits***

We are proud to offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including:

· Performance Incentives

· Paid travel expenses

· Professional development

· 401(k) plus matching

· Dental insurance

· Health insurance

· Life insurance

· Vision insurance

· Paid time off

***About Homecrest***  
Located in Wadena, MN, Homecrest Outdoor Living is a leading manufacturer of premium outdoor furniture. Since our founding in 1953, we’ve been dedicated to creating comfortable, durable products that help our customers enjoy life outdoors. Our commitment to quality craftsmanship and American manufacturing has made Homecrest a trusted name for generations. In fact, many of our iconic wire collections from the 1960s are still in use today, reflecting the lasting quality built into every piece we make.

***Our Core Values***

At Homecrest, our culture is built on a foundation of four core values. We are looking for team members who share our commitment to these principles:

* **Passion:** We are driven, enthusiastic, dedicated, and proud. We take pride in creating high\-quality products that help people love life outdoors.
* **Innovation:** We embrace new ideas and think outside the box. We are constantly seeking better ways to improve our products and our process.
* **Accountability:** We do what we say we will do and take responsibility. We own our work and our results, ensuring the Homecrest name always represents quality.
* **Integrity:** We are open and honest, building trust through transparency and upholding strong ethical values. We believe in doing the right thing, every time.

The Ohio State University College of Optometry seeks a temporary Health Systems Administration Transition \& Training Consultant to provide specialized knowledge transfer and transition support following the departure of the College's Health Systems Administration Analyst.


The primary purpose of this temporary assignment is to facilitate the successful transition of Compulink EHR administration and management. Sharing of knowledge and training on the processes, procedures, and technical practices to the employee assuming responsibility for these functions. The consultant will work with the incoming employee, the Associate Dean for Clinical Services, and College IT leadership to provide training, orientation, documentation, and transition support based on established Compulink EHR systems, processes, and workflows.


***This is a temporary transition and training assignment*** . ***Work will be virtual and is expected to average approximately 6 hours per week, as needed, and hours may vary based on the needs of the transition. Work may not be required every week.***

The assignment is intended solely to support knowledge transfer, training, documentation, and transition activities associated with the clinic EHR administration functions. ***The assignment will conclude no later than November 26, 2026, unless ended earlier by the College.***

The consultant is not expected to assume the full scope of ongoing responsibilities associated with the former full\-time Health Systems Administration Analyst position.


The Health Systems Administration Transition \& Training Consultant will provide specialized training and knowledge transfer related to the College of Optometry's Compulink EHR environment and systems administration functions.


The consultant will:


* Provide one\-on\-one and/or small\-group virtual training to the incoming health systems administration employee on College\-specific systems, technology environments, processes, procedures, and workflows.
* Transfer institutional and technical knowledge necessary for the incoming employee to assume responsibility for health systems administration functions.
* Explain existing systems configurations, dependencies, integrations, support processes, and operational considerations relevant to the clinic’s EHR technology environment.
* Demonstrate established procedures for system monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, security practices, and related systems administration activities, as appropriate.
* Provide orientation to relevant College, University, and technology\-partner relationships, including key contacts, escalation procedures, vendors, and support resources.
* Review existing documentation and identify areas where additional clarification or documentation would support a successful transition.
* Develop or update transition documentation, job aids, process guides, system reference materials, and other resources needed by the incoming employee.
* Provide context regarding historical system decisions, known issues, recurring problems, system dependencies, and other institutional knowledge that may not be fully captured in existing documentation.
* Support the incoming employee in understanding appropriate troubleshooting and escalation procedures.
* Answer questions and provide clarification as the incoming employee assumes responsibility for assigned systems and processes.
* Coordinate with the Associate Dean for Clinical Services and College IT leadership to identify and prioritize critical knowledge\-transfer activities during the temporary assignment.
* Perform other transition and training\-related duties as assigned by the Associate Dean of Clinical Services.
